info.title: Xunics API
info.description:
API for customer purchasing integrations. Authenticate with an API key created in the console;
console JWTs do not work here. All amounts are USD decimal strings, all timestamps are
ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.

Multiple keys belonging to the same user share that user's balance and rate limits.

## Quick start

1. Register and sign in at `https://xunics.com` (email code, GitHub or Google)
2. Go to **Profile → API Keys** and create a key. **The plaintext key is shown only once**
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` with every request

```bash
# Look up listings
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://xunics.com/api/public/v1/items?market_hash_name=AK-47%20%7C%20Redline%20(Field-Tested)"

# Order by name, cheapest first
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://xunics.com/api/public/v1/orders/quick -d '{
    "external_order_no": "your-order-0001",
    "market_hash_name": "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)",
    "max_price": "12.00",
    "trade_url": "https://steamcommunity.com/tradeoffer/new/?partner=123456789&token=AbCdEfGh"
  }'

# Poll for status
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://xunics.com/api/public/v1/orders?external_order_no=your-order-0001"
```

Your balance must be funded first. Top-ups are currently confirmed manually, so contact support.

## Choosing an order endpoint

| Endpoint | Use it when | What gets bought |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /v1/orders` | You picked a listing via `/v1/items` | Pinned by `quote_id`, valid 60 seconds |
| `POST /v1/orders/quick` | You only care about name and price | Cheapest listing within your cap |
| `POST /v1/orders/quick/batch` | Several orders at once | As above, one order each, partial success |

`max_price` is the **maximum total payable including all fees**. If the item sells for less,
you are charged the actual price and the difference is released.

## Idempotency and timeout recovery

`external_order_no` is unique per user and acts as your idempotency key. The server
fingerprints `external_order_no` together with every order parameter:

- Repeated request with identical parameters → returns **the original order**, nothing is bought twice
- Parameters differ → `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`: an order with this number already exists

If a request times out or you never see the response, **resend exactly the same request**: same
`external_order_no`, same parameters. If the first request created the order you get that order
back; if it is still being processed, the resend waits for it and then returns the same order.

Two things must never be done while recovering:

- **Never switch to a new `external_order_no`.** The first request may still go through, and
  then you have bought twice. This includes `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`: look that order up instead.
- **Never take an empty lookup as proof the order does not exist.** A lookup by your own number
  returning `total: 0` only means nothing has been committed *yet*; a request that is still
  waiting on the server can commit a moment later.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://xunics.com/api/public/v1/orders?external_order_no=your-order-0001"
```

## Order status and where the money is

| Status | Meaning | Funds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | Accepted, waiting to be processed | Locked |
| `processing` | Being ordered from the source | Locked |
| `awaiting_acceptance` | Bought, waiting for the recipient to accept the Steam offer | Locked |
| `completed` | Delivered; can still be reversed until `reversible_until` | Charged |
| `failed` | Purchase failed (final) | Released |
| `cancelled` | Cancelled (final) | Released |
| `reversed` | Trade reversed after delivery (final) | Returned once the source refunds us |

`awaiting_acceptance` is not a sale yet: if the recipient declines the offer or it expires, the
order fails and the funds are released. `refund_pending` stays true while a reversed order's
money is on its way back.

`payment_status` is the independent view from the funding side: `held` locked,
`captured` charged, `released` unlocked, `refunded` refunded. Book money by `payment_status`,
not by the order status.

An order stops changing once it is `failed` or `cancelled`, `completed` with `reversible_until`
in the past, or `reversed` with `refund_pending` false. Keep polling until then.

`processing` can last a long time, more than an hour when the result at the source cannot be
confirmed yet. That is not a failure: do not time the order out on your side and buy again under
a new number, because the first order may still complete.

Order status has **no callbacks** yet, so you need to poll. Reads and writes use
**separate rate-limit buckets**, so polling at a normal rate will not eat into your ordering quota.

## Rate limits

| Group | Quota | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Item lookups | 60/minute | Per user |
| Order and wallet reads | 240/minute | Per user |
| Order writes | 60/minute | Per user; batch endpoints count per request |

Exceeding a limit returns `429 RATE_LIMITED` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

## Errors

Every error response has the same shape:

```json
{"code": 422, "msg": "...", "data": null, "error_code": "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
 "trace_id": "...", "details": [{"field": "body.max_price", "type": "greater_than", "msg": "..."}]}
```

**Branch on `error_code`, never on `msg`.** `details` appears only for request validation
failures and names the offending field. Include `trace_id` when reporting a problem.

### Worth retrying with backoff

- `API_UNAVAILABLE`
- `INTERNAL_ERROR`
- `MARKET_UNAVAILABLE`
- `PRICING_UNAVAILABLE`
- `RATE_LIMITED`
- `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`
- `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`

These are transient. Retrying after `Retry-After` (or with exponential backoff if absent) makes sense.

### Not worth retrying

- `ACCOUNT_DISABLED`
- `API_KEY_DISABLED`
- `API_KEY_EXPIRED`
- `API_KEY_REQUIRED`
- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`
- `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`
- `INVALID_API_KEY`
- `INVALID_ARGUMENT`
- `MALFORMED_JSON`
- `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`
- `NOT_FOUND`
- `ORDER_CONFLICT`
- `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`
- `PERMISSION_DENIED`
- `PRICE_LIMIT_TOO_LOW`
- `QUOTE_NOT_FOUND`
- `QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE`
- `REQUEST_REJECTED`
- `SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED`
- `WALLET_NOT_FOUND`
- `WALLET_UNAVAILABLE`

These return the same result no matter how many times you retry: either change the request or
contact support. Two of them need care:

- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` means an order with that `external_order_no` already exists. Look it up;
  do not resend under a new number.
- `SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED` means purchasing has not been set up on the platform at all, so contact
  support. A source that is only temporarily out of service returns `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`, which
  is worth retrying.

get.summary: Fetch one of your active quotes
get.description: Returns the original quote without re-pricing it or extending its validity. Any API key belonging to the same user can read the same quote.

post.summary: Buy a specific listing by quote
post.description: Locks funds up to your fee-inclusive price cap and purchases asynchronously. A returned order means accepted, not bought or delivered. external_order_no is unique per user and every retry must keep all parameters identical. Any valid API key may purchase.

get.description: Supports lookup by your own order number. Reads the stored order state only; it never triggers a purchase or calls the source.

parameters.name: external_order_no

schema.description: Look up by your own order number
schema.title: External Order No

parameters.description: Look up by your own order number

post.description: Give only the exact market hash name and a fee-inclusive price cap; the source picks the cheapest listing within that cap. Nothing is reserved. Omitting delivery_type means bot delivery. Manual delivery requires a source account with that permission and a trade URL already whitelisted by the source. external_order_no is unique per user and every retry must keep all parameters identical.

post.summary: Batch buy by name, cheapest first
post.description: Up to 20 items per request. Each becomes an independent order with its own fund lock, and partial success is allowed. Results come back in request order. A rejected entry created no order and can be retried with the same external_order_no, except IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: an order with that number already exists, so look it up instead.

market_hash_name.title: Market Hash Name
market_hash_name.description: Steam name; empty when the source has no matching tradable item

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Steam image URL; empty when the source does not provide one or the item is not from Steam

external_order_no.description: Your own order number, unique per user. Repeated requests must keep every parameter identical

max_price.description: Maximum total payable as a USD decimal string, all fees included

trade_url.title: Trade Url
trade_url.description: Steam trade offer URL of the recipient, e.g. https://steamcommunity.com/tradeoffer/new/?partner=123456789&token=AbCdEfGh . Must be https. Only the partner and token are used: the "www." prefix, a missing trailing slash, extra query parameters and fragments are accepted and stripped, and the value is stored in canonical form. The canonical form is what the idempotency fingerprint is computed from.

quote_id.title: Quote Id
quote_id.description: One of your active quote identifiers

CreateOrderParam.description: Buy a specific listing: the quote pins one item and its delivery method.

CreateQuickOrderParam.title: CreateQuickOrderParam
CreateQuickOrderParam.description:
Quick buy: give only a name and a price cap; the source picks the cheapest listing
within it. Nothing is reserved.

field.title: Field
field.description: Location of the offending field, e.g. body.max_price or query.float_min

type.title: Type
type.description: Validation failure type, e.g. missing, greater_than

msg.title: Msg
msg.description: Error description; do not branch on it

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier; see PublicErrorCode for values

trace_id.title: Trace Id
trace_id.description: Trace identifier for investigating the request

details.title: Details
details.description: Per-field reasons for validation failures; empty for other errors

kind.description: listing = a specific listing pinned by quote, quick = by name, cheapest first

quote_id.title: Quote Id
quote_id.description: Quote identifier for a pinned listing; empty for quick orders

item.description: Quick orders carry only the name and delivery method until the source picks a listing; trade details are filled in afterwards

quoted_price.description: Fee-inclusive quote at lookup time, for reference only; quick orders have none

max_price.description: Maximum total you authorised us to pay

actual_price.description: Fee-inclusive total once the trade is confirmed; empty until then

paid_amount.description: Total actually charged to your wallet

refunded_amount.description: Amount already returned to your wallet

refund_pending.title: Refund Pending
refund_pending.description: Trade was reversed and the refund is being reconciled

steam_offer_id.title: Steam Offer Id
steam_offer_id.description: Steam trade offer id for the recipient to accept; empty until issued

reversible_until.title: Reversible Until
reversible_until.description: Known end of the trade protection window

quote_id.title: Quote Id
quote_id.description: Xunics quote identifier for one specific listing; usable only by the owning user

price.description: Amount payable, decimal string with 8 decimal places

quoted_at.title: Quoted At
quoted_at.description: When the quote was generated, with timezone

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the quote expires; re-query after that. Does not reserve the listing

data_at.title: Data At
data_at.description: Timestamp of the listing data behind this quote. Data can lag, so the item may already be sold

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of matching listings for this query; changes with the market

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Phase, empty string when the item has none

delivery_type.description: Requested delivery method; the order confirms what actually happened

QuickOrderBasket.title: QuickOrderBasket
QuickOrderBasket.description:
Several quick orders at once; each becomes its own order with its own fund hold,
and partial success is allowed.

external_order_no.title: External Order No
external_order_no.description: Your own order number, used to line results up with the request

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: True when this entry has an order: a new one with funds locked, or the existing one returned for an identical replay, whatever its status

order.description: The order when accepted; empty when rejected

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: Machine-readable identifier for the rejection reason. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT means an order with this number already exists: look it up instead of resending under a new number

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable rejection reason; do not branch on it

QuickOrderResult.title: QuickOrderResult
QuickOrderResult.description: Result for one basket entry; a failure does not affect the others.

market_hash_name.title: Market Hash Name
market_hash_name.description: Steam name; empty when the source has no matching tradable item

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Steam image URL; empty when the source does not provide one or the item is not from Steam

locked_balance.description: Held by orders but not yet charged

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the wallet is manually enabled; not the same as purchasing being enabled

amount.description: Amount originally locked for the order

refundable_amount.description: Charged amount still refundable; not an invitation to request a refund

created_time.title: Created Time
created_time.description: Hold creation time, ISO 8601 with timezone

updated_time.title: Updated Time
updated_time.description: Last update time, ISO 8601 with timezone

id.description: Ledger entry identifier; treat it as a string

kind.description: Top-up, adjustment, hold, capture, release or refund

order_no.title: Order No
order_no.description: Related Xunics order number; empty for non-order entries

amount.description: Amount for this operation; use the delta fields for the actual balance change

balance_delta.description: Change in total balance, positive adds, negative subtracts

locked_delta.description: Change in locked balance, positive adds, negative subtracts

XunicsApiKey.description: An API key created in your profile. Console JWTs are not accepted.
